description: This PHP source file defines the AppSetupUtility class, which manages database setup, migrations, configuration, and installation procedures for the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: AppSetupUtility
classes.description: Utility class for managing database setup, migrations, and configuration during system installation.

methods.name: getConfigHelper
methods.description: Lazy initializer for ConfigHelper instance.

methods.name: getSystemConfiguration
methods.description: Lazy initializer for SystemConfiguration instance.

methods.name: getMigrationHelper
methods.description: Lazy initializer for MigrationHelper instance.

methods.name: createNewDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new database schema with the specified name.

methods.name: connectToDatabaseServer
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database server without selecting a specific database.

methods.name: isDatabaseExist
methods.description: Checks if a database with the given name exists.

methods.name: isDatabaseUserExist
methods.description: Checks if a database user exists.

methods.name: connectToDatabase
methods.description: Establishes a connection to an existing database.

methods.name: isExistingDatabaseEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the existing database has no tables (is empty).

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates a database based on installation type and existing database state.

methods.name: insertSystemConfiguration
methods.description: Inserts system configuration data, including CSRF key, organization info, admin user, and instance ID.

methods.name: getVersionsInRange
methods.description: Returns a list of migration versions within a specified range.

methods.name: runMigrations
methods.description: Runs database migrations from a starting version to an optional target version.

methods.name: runMigrationFor
methods.description: Runs migration for a specific version.

methods.name: getCurrentProductVersionFromDatabase
methods.description: Retrieves the current product version stored in the database.

methods.name: cleanUpInstallOnFailure
methods.description: Drops all tables and disables foreign key checks to clean up after failed installation.

methods.name: dropDatabase
methods.description: Drops the specified database.

methods.name: writeConfFile
methods.description: Generates and writes the configuration file based on database info.

methods.name: writeKeyFile
methods.description: Creates a security key file.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a unique instance identifier based on system data.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifierData
methods.description: Gathers data used to generate the instance identifier.

methods.name: createDBUser
methods.description: Creates database user accounts with appropriate privileges.
